full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media fantasy poster shows a pale human face in left-facing three-quarter profile dissolving into dark birds and fragmented architecture on a warm off-white ground. The background is almost empty cream, leaving wide clean margins around the central image. At the center-left, the youthful face is rendered softly in cool gray and muted rose, with downcast dark eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. The expression is pensive and still. Across the top and right side of the head, the hair or upper silhouette transforms into a dense collage of dark blue-black marks, weathered rust patches, and small building facades. Tiny rooflines, windows, and broken structural fragments can be glimpsed inside the textured mass. From the upper-right edge of this mass, many dark bird silhouettes scatter into the open cream space, growing smaller and more widely separated toward the corner. The lower neck and shoulder also break apart into rough printed fragments and smudges rather than a clear garment. Fine speckling crosses parts of the cheek and temple, so the realistic modeling seems to erode into the collage. Below and left of the face, the word FATE appears in widely spaced uppercase dark serif letters. No other writing is clearly legible. Lighting is soft and frontal on the face, with a delicate shadow under the eye and nose, while the textured upper mass depends more on dark-light fragmentation than a single physical light source. Warm rust flecks punctuate the largely cream, charcoal, and ink-blue palette. The overall composition is sparse but emotionally dense, balancing one quiet likeness, explosive rightward dispersal, and ample negative space in a distressed printed image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介奇幻海报呈现一张朝左的浅色四分之三侧面人脸，在暖灰白底上消散成深色飞鸟与建筑碎片。背景几乎是空白乳色，在中央图像周围留下宽阔干净的边距。中央偏左的年轻面庞以冷灰和低饱和玫瑰色柔和绘成，深色眼睛略垂，鼻梁笔直，嘴唇微张，神情沉思而静止。头部上方和右侧，头发或上部剪影变成深蓝黑笔痕、磨旧锈色斑块与细小建筑立面的密集拼贴。纹理团中隐约可见细小屋顶线、窗洞和破碎构造片段。许多深色飞鸟剪影从这团纹理的右上边缘飞散到开阔乳白空间，向角落越去越小，也越分散。下方颈部与肩膀同样碎成粗涩印刷片段和污迹，而没有清楚衣物。细微颗粒跨过部分脸颊和太阳穴，使写实塑形仿佛被拼贴侵蚀。面庞左下方，以字距宽松的深色大写衬线字母写着“FATE”。没有其他清楚可读的文字。脸上的光线柔和且从正面而来，眼下与鼻下带细腻阴影；上方纹理团则更多依靠深浅碎裂，而非单一实体光源。暖锈色小点打破以乳白、炭黑和墨蓝为主的配色。整体构图稀疏却情绪浓密，让一道安静的面孔、向右爆散的动势和宽裕负空间在磨旧印刷画面中相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media poster treatment places a softly modeled pale focal area against extensive warm off-white negative space. Dark ink-blue and charcoal fragments accumulate around one side, then disperse outward as increasingly small graphic marks. Scraped edges, printed speckle, architectural-looking linework, and occasional rust-colored flecks create an eroded collage surface. The transition from smooth tonal modeling to broken texture is gradual in one direction and abrupt in another, making disintegration itself the compositional movement. High contrast is localized within the dense mass; the rest of the frame stays airy and quiet. Text, when present, is sparse, widely spaced, and set in restrained dark serif forms. Illumination remains gentle on the softly shaded center, while the surrounding fragments behave like ink and paper rather than natural lit objects. The overall effect is reflective, fateful, and slightly haunted, with material breakup and asymmetric dispersal carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介海报处理把柔和塑形的浅色焦点区域放在大面积暖灰白负空间前。深墨蓝与炭灰碎片在一侧积聚，再向外散成越来越小的图形笔痕。刮擦边缘、印刷颗粒、带构造感的线纹和偶尔的锈色小点组成受侵蚀的拼贴表面。从平滑明暗塑形到破碎肌理的过渡，在一个方向上渐进，在另一方向上突变，让消散本身成为构图动势。高反差集中于密实的部分；画幅其余区域保持轻盈安静。若有文字，使用稀少、字距宽阔且克制的深色衬线形式。柔和阴影中心的照明保持温和，周围碎片则像墨与纸，而非自然受光物体。整体效果内省、带宿命感且略显幽暗，材料碎裂与不对称散开承载画风。
theme_en: A pale profile dissolving into birds and fragmented architecture
theme_zh: 浅色侧面面庞消散为飞鸟与建筑碎片
name: Fate
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
